query: SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.data_key_id, d.nik_enc FROM app.account_owner_nik_registry g JOIN app.care_recipient cr ON cr.id = g.care_recipient_id JOIN app.patient p ON p.id = cr.patient_id JOIN app.identity_verification_request r ON r.id = g.identity_verification_request_id JOIN app.identity_document d ON d.id = r.identity_document_id WHERE p.account_id = $1 AND cr.is_account_owner AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND cr.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY g.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
